searches.reason: Investigate whether easy sampled negatives obscure ranking weaknesses, especially in Electronics. Seek a practical objective change within one HSTU model per category; compare using fixed macro validation HR@10, since large training margins do not establish generalization.
searches.query: HSTU sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026 sampled softmax logQ correction mixed hard negative sampling false negatives ranking generalization

searches.reason: Explore how HSTU can distinguish a current task from persistent historical interest using causal, jointly trained temporal gates. Public training timestamps support this direction, but fulfilled needs remain hypotheses rather than observed labels.
searches.query: HSTU temporal sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026 relative time bias recency gating short long term intent next item prediction

searches.reason: Find methods for integrating specific content and compatibility evidence into the HSTU item representation. Use only available titles and descriptions, with text features learned from scratch inside the single network; investigate whether these improve sparse-item ranking without assuming unavailable attributes.
searches.query: content enriched HSTU sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026 jointly trained title description encoder attribute compatibility sparse items without pretrained embeddings
